meta.name: eureka
meta.description: Capture technical breakthroughs and transform them into actionable, reusable documentation. Use this skill when the user has achieved a significant technical insight, solved a hard problem, discovered a non-obvious solution, or wants to document a breakthrough moment. Also trigger when the user mentions "eureka", "breakthrough", "document this insight", "capture this discovery", or wants to turn a technical win into reusable knowledge.

copy.tagline: 把技术突破转化为可复用的文档
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果常遇到技术突破却来不及记录，想沉淀为团队知识
copy.tagline_en: Turn technical breakthroughs into reusable documentation
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often achieve technical breakthroughs but struggle to document them for reuse

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

howto.what: 当你有技术突破时，Claude 会帮你记录问题、洞察、前后变化和最小示例，生成结构化的 Markdown 文件，并更新索引，最后提炼可复用的模式。
howto.when: 当你提到“eureka”、“突破”、“记录这个洞察”等关键词，或者你刚解决了一个难题、发现了一个非显而易见的解法时触发。

say.text: 我刚刚解决了那个内存泄漏问题，帮我记录这个突破。
say.note: Claude 会收集细节并生成突破文件。

say.text: eureka，我发现了一个优化数据库查询的技巧。

howto.what_en: When you have a technical breakthrough, Claude captures the problem, insight, before/after, and minimal example, creates a structured markdown file, updates an index, and extracts reusable patterns.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention "eureka", "breakthrough", "document this insight", or similar; or when you've just solved a hard problem or discovered a non-obvious solution.

say_en.text: I just fixed that memory leak, help me document this breakthrough.
say_en.note: Claude will gather details and create the file.

say_en.text: Eureka, I found a trick to optimize database queries.
say_en.note: Triggers the skill to start recording.
